sentences.text: The known fossil material includes a partial skeleton with vertebrae, ribs, a jaw, some teeth, and limb bones. This specimen represents an adult individual of the species.
The scientific description of Marambionectes sparked controversy because the researchers used AI-generated images to illustrate the animal.

The holotype specimen of Marambionectes was discovered in 2018 near Marambio Island in Antarctica. Marambionectes molinai was formally described as a new genus and species in 2024 by O'Gorman and colleagues. The species name molinai honors Argentinian fossil preparator Omar J. Molina for his field work in Antarctica.

Phylogenetic analyses place Marambionectes within the Weddellonectia clade as the sister group to the Aristonectinae. Marambionectes is classified as a reptile belonging to the family Elasmosauridae and the parent group Weddellonectia.
Marambionectes was an extinct plesiosaur that lived in Antarctica during the Late Cretaceous. Marambionectes lived between 72.2 and 66 million years ago during the Maastrichtian stage.
